not_empty_record.says: true when a raw record has any field with content; a blank line is not a record

with_index.says: a raw record with its 1-based data-record index; the index counts records after the header, blank lines included, so quoted newlines never shift it

data_records.says: the data records of a parsed file with indices, blank lines dropped

drop_first_item.says: the list without its first item

item_after.says: the item one position after the index in a

transform.says: the whole batch result for a supplier file: lexical outcome, header check, validation report, and the normalised snapshot when accepted

run.says: the batch entry point: transform, show the report on the panel, and export the snapshot only when accepted

clamp_to.says: x held between lo and hi inclusive; never use it to hide an unavailable quantity

same_text.says: 1 when the two texts in a pair are the same scalar sequence, else 0

unique_text.says: true when no two texts in the list are the same scalar sequence; the empty list is unique

is_sorted_pair.says: 1 when the text in a is not after the text in b

min_text.says: the smallest text in a non-empty list by scalar sequence

is_min_of.says: true when the text in a is not after any text in the list in b

digits_fit.says: true when a digit string, without its leading zeros, denotes a number no larger than the exact maximum; decided by length and then by text comparison, never by converting

parse_decimal_nat.says: the value of a string of ASCII digits; refuses anything else and refuses a value that would leave the exact range, before converting

header_ok.says: true when the header is exactly SKU,NAME,PRICE_VND,QTY_ON_HAND

field_problem.says: the first problem with a raw record, as a located diagnostic {index field problem}, or none

problem_count.says: 1 when a diagnostic names a problem, else 0

has_problem.says: true when a diagnostic names a problem

normalize_record.says: a validated raw record as a product: SKU kept, NAME preserved, PRICE_VND and QTY_ON_HAND as exact numbers; the validation guarantees the conversions cannot refuse

index_of.says: the data-record index of a raw record

sku_dup.says: 1 when the two raw records in a pair carry the same SKU text and are different records, else 0

involved_in_dup.says: true when the raw record in a shares its SKU with another record in the list in b

raw_of.says: the raw record of a pair

duplicate_indices.says: the data-record indices of every record whose SKU appears more than once, in file order

validate_snapshot.says: every located field diagnostic, the duplicate-SKU indices, and whether the snapshot is accepted: accepted only when there are records, no field problems and no duplicates

index_ok.says: 1 when a raw record's index is at least 1

accepted_of.says: the accepted flag of a validation result

sku_before.says: true when the product in a sorts strictly before the product in b by SKU

count_before.says: how many products in the list in b sort before the product in a; with unique SKUs this is its position

swap.says: the pair with a and b exchanged

at_position.says: the product in the list in b whose position by SKU order is the index in a; the SKUs must be unique for positions to be unique

position_is.says: true when the product in a has the wanted position within the list carried in b

normalize_snapshot.says: the accepted snapshot as products sorted by SKU; refuses a snapshot that validate_snapshot does not accept

line_ok.says: 1 when the line in a is a valid cart line against the stock in b: quantity 1–9, known SKU, within availability; 0 against invalid stock

cart_ok.says: true when the stock is valid and the cart has at most 3 lines, with distinct SKUs, each valid against the stock

set_qty_if.says: the line in a with the quantity of the line in b when their SKUs match, else unchanged

other_sku.says: true when the line in a does not carry the SKU in b

remove_line.says: the lines without the one carrying the SKU

set_line.says: the cart with a product's quantity set; 0 removes the line; a new SKU adds a line

add_one.says: the cart with one more of a product

priced_line.says: the cart line in a priced from the stock in b: name and unit price captured, subtotal = price × qty

priced.says: every cart line priced from the stock

subtotal_of.says: the subtotal of a priced line

total_of.says: the exact total of priced lines: the sum of their subtotals

price_pos.says: 1 when a line's unit price is positive

bare.says: a line reduced to its intent: SKU and quantity

canonical_intent.says: the lines as intent: SKU and quantity only, sorted by SKU, so the same purchase written in any order compares equal

order_ok.says: 1 when an order is well formed: positive id, 1–3 priced lines with distinct SKUs, total equal to the sum of subtotals, known status

subtotal_if.says: a line's subtotal when it equals price × qty, else −1 so the order total cannot match

id_text.says: an order's id as text, for uniqueness checks

orders_ok.says: true when every order is well formed and ids are unique

is_open.says: true when an order still holds its reservation: ready, pending or unknown

held_by.says: the units of the SKU in b held by the order in a: its line quantity while open, else 0

held.says: the units of a SKU held by all open orders

item_held_ok.says: 1 when the reservation of the item in a equals the units held by the open orders in b

reservations_consistent.says: true when every item's reservation is exactly what the open orders hold, and open orders name only stocked SKUs

line_known.says: 1 when the line in a names a SKU carried by the stock in b

open_lines_known.says: 1 when the order in a is closed, or every line of it names a SKU in the stock in b

id_matches.says: true when the order in a has the id in b

has_order.says: true when exactly one order has the id

status_of.says: the status of the order with an id

set_status_if.says: the order in a with the status in b when the ids match, else unchanged

with_status.says: the orders with one order's status replaced; lines and total untouched

same_intent.says: true when the cart lines mean the same purchase as the order's captured lines: same SKUs with the same quantities, in any order

new_order.says: an order created from priced lines: captured prices, exact total, status ready

available.says: the units of a stock item a customer may still reserve: on hand minus reserved

stock_item_ok.says: 1 when a stock item is well formed: SKU text, nonempty name, positive price, 0 ≤ reserved ≤ on hand

stock_ok.says: true when every stock item is well formed and SKUs are unique

sku_matches.says: true when the item in a carries the SKU text in b

hits.says: the items carrying a SKU, in list order

known.says: true when exactly one item carries the SKU

find_item.says: the one item carrying the SKU

qty_if_sku.says: the quantity of the line in a when it carries the SKU in b, else 0

needed.says: how many units of a SKU a list of lines asks for

qty_nonneg.says: 1 when a line asks for zero or more units

lines_ok.says: true when no line asks for a negative quantity

line_fits.says: 1 when the line in a names a known SKU in the stock in b and asks for no more than is available

lines_fit.says: true when every line fits the stock on its own; lines with distinct SKUs then fit together

reserve_by_lines.says: the item in a with the units the lines in b need added to its reservation

reserve_all.says: the stock with every line reserved, as one step: all lines fit or nothing changes

release_by_lines.says: the item in a with the units the lines in b need taken off its reservation

release_all.says: the stock with every line's reservation released

consume_by_lines.says: the item in a after the units the lines in b need are sold: off the shelf and off the reservation

consume_all.says: the stock after every line is sold

refresh_item.says: the item in a updated from the snapshot records in b when listed: name and price follow the supplier, on hand becomes the supplier's unsold count; reservations are kept

not_listed.says: true when the record in a names a SKU absent from the items in b

new_item.says: a stock item for a snapshot record new to the shop: nothing reserved yet

new_items.says: stock items for the snapshot records the shop does not carry yet, in record order

is_conflict.says: true when the snapshot records in b list the item in a with fewer units than it has reserved

conflict_view.says: a conflict as the operator sees it: SKU, units reserved, units the supplier reports

conflicts.says: every SKU whose reported units are below its reservation; a snapshot with any is rejected whole

record_ok.says: 1 when a snapshot record is a well-formed product: SKU text, nonempty name, positive price, nonnegative units

records_ok.says: true when every snapshot record is well formed

apply_snapshot.says: the stock after a whole supplier snapshot: listed SKUs take the supplier's counts, names and prices; unlisted SKUs are kept; new SKUs are added; reservations never change

change_of.says: what a snapshot record in a does to availability given the stock in b: available before and after

changes.says: the availability change for every snapshot record
